title: Membership movement lab
description: Compare exact ownership before and after one node joins or leaves. The fixture keeps key hashes stable so only the placement strategy changes.

virtualNodeOptions.label: One token
virtualNodeOptions.detail: Easy to inspect, but random gaps can create severe ownership skew.

virtualNodeOptions.label: Four tokens
virtualNodeOptions.detail: Splits each physical owner into several smaller ranges.

virtualNodeOptions.label: Twelve tokens
virtualNodeOptions.detail: Produces finer ranges in this teaching fixture, with more token metadata.

changes.label: Add node D
changes.detail: A new equal-capacity owner takes only the ranges ending at its tokens.

changes.label: Remove node C
changes.detail: The removed owner's ranges advance to their next clockwise owners.

modelNote: This is a deterministic teaching sample, not a statistical guarantee. Production validation must measure the deployed hash, weights, key distribution, bytes, and request rate.
